subject: Pilot request: Adapter + Marketplace listing visibility
messages:
From: Asha Nair <asha@dataforge.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot request: Adapter + Marketplace listing visibility

Hi Jasmine,

Quick intro — I’m Asha, Head of Partnerships at DataForge AI. We’ve built an enterprise connector that routes model inference through a managed adaptor layer; several joint customers asked us to publish a managed listing for both AWS Marketplace and GCP Marketplace and to include a ‘sell-with’/co-sell routing tag.

We’re hoping Redwood can support a small pilot:
- Two-week PoC (connect a sandbox account + 1 integration customer)
- Seed credits for POC (GPU credits or equivalent)
- Marketplace catalog visibility (co-sell checkbox + feature blurb) during the pilot

What we can share immediately: SOC 2 summary, short architecture diagram, and a partner MSA draft — I can attach those. Can you confirm required evidence and the right person on your side to own the co-sell entitlements & listing visibility?

Thanks — appreciate any quick pointers.

Best,
Asha Nair
Head of Partnerships, DataForge AI
asha@dataforge.ai
--Attachment: security_questionnaire.pdf (PDF, 128 KB)
--Attachment: arch_diagram.png (PNG, 420 KB)
--Attachment: partner_msa_draft.docx (DOCX, 85 KB)

From: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Asha Nair <asha@dataforge.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 22 Jul 2028 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request: Adapter + Marketplace listing visibility

Hi Asha — welcome, and thanks for the quick background.

This sounds promising and aligns with a couple of current co-sell paths we’re validating. High-level asks from our side to accelerate:
1) Security & compliance: completed SOC 2 Type II report (or most recent SOC 2 summary + point of contact), filled security questionnaire (we received the PDF stub — thanks).
2) Architecture: a one-page diagram showing where the adaptor sits relative to customer VPCs and whether any egress or network peering is required (the arch_diagram.png helps).
3) SKU & billing mapping: a recommended SKU name(s) and how meterable units map to requests/instances (we’ll use this for the pilot billing mapping).
4) Commercial: partner MSA draft + any standard SOW language for PoC credits and pilot support.

Operationally I’ll loop in Ben (alliance ops) and Karthik (partner metering/bundling) — cc’d. Ben, can you take point on catalog visibility + co-sell tagging? Karthik, we’ll need a quick review of their SKU mapping for sell-with entitlements.

Suggested next step: 30-minute kickoff next week to align timeline and confirm the POC credit amount. Are you available Tue/Wed (PST)?

I’ll also assign an internal owner to drive the listing intake once PoC confirms.

Thanks,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Alliance Manager — Cloud Partnerships
Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Phone: (415) 555-0198

From: Asha Nair <asha@dataforge.ai>
To: jasmine_liu@redwood.ai
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@dataforge.ai>, partner-success@dataforge.ai
Date: Mon, 25 Jul 2028 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot request: Adapter + Marketplace listing visibility

Thanks Jasmine — Tue/Wed next week works for us. I pulled the attachments into the thread and added Sam (engineering lead) for technical follow-up. Summary below:

- SOC 2: we’re attaching the SOC 2 summary and the control owner contact (Sam is copied).
- Architecture: attached diagram shows adaptor as a managed sidecar in customer VPC with optional PrivateLink; no persistent egress from customer to us unless PrivateLink is selected.
- SKU proposal: DataForge-Adaptor-PROC-1 (per-inference-unit) + DataForge-Adaptor-instance (per-hour) — see short table in attached doc.
- Commercial: MSA draft attached; we’re flexible on pilot credit allocation but propose $10k equivalent (covering test instances + support).

Attachments: security_questionnaire.pdf, arch_diagram.png, partner_msa_draft.docx, sku_pricing_table.xlsx (incoming via Drive link).

For the kickoff, we prefer Wed 07/28 at 10:00 AM PST. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite with a brief agenda (POC scope, success metrics, logging/telemetry requirements, runbook).

Appreciate the rapid reply — Sam can answer any detailed design questions during the kickoff.

—Asha
Asha Nair
Head of Partnerships, DataForge AI
asha@dataforge.ai
Sam Lee (eng): sam.lee@dataforge.ai

Subject: Re: Pilot request: Adapter + Marketplace listing visibility

Perfect — Wed 07/28 10:00 AM PST works; please send the invite.

Internal note for Ben / Karthik / Monica:
- Ben: please prepare the catalog intake checklist (evidence binder we require for a co-sell badge + writing the marketplace blurb). Target: have the intake opened by EOD 7/29.
- Karthik: can you review the proposed SKU mapping pre-kickoff and flag any metering incompatibilities?
- Monica: I’m assigning you as the internal co-sell owner for this partner (DF-POC-8732) — you’ll be the contact for partner entitlements and will own the listing visibility process.

Asha — thanks for the attachments. We’ll review the SOC2 summary and the questionnaire over the next two days and come prepared with a runbook ask at the kickoff. If possible, please add the Drive link with the sku_pricing_table.xlsx to the calendar invite so Karthik can pre-read.

Looking forward — talk soon.

Best,
Jasmine
